cohort: 2113 pregnant women in Klang Valley, Malaysia, with first-trimester booking at 12 weeks and below, registered with the Malaysian National Obstetric Registry (NOR) in 2015
finding: Indian and Malay ethnicity, multiparity, and grand multiparity were significantly associated with maternal obesity, which was also significantly associated with hypertensive disorder in pregnancy, caesarean section delivery, and macrosomic infants.
mod_finding: Maternal obesity was significantly associated with caesarean section delivery.
